name: hubspot
description: Work with HubSpot CRM contacts, companies, deals, and tickets using a private-app token. Load for CRM lookups, searches, and updates.

content.inline:
## HubSpot
Calls go through `v/ops/http/get` / `v/ops/http/post` against `https://api.hubapi.com` with `bearerSecret: "s/HUBSPOT_TOKEN"` (a private-app access token: Settings → Integrations → Private Apps; scoped, non-expiring). Only the secret reference goes in the request; never the token itself.

CRM v3 patterns (`{object}` is `contacts`, `companies`, `deals`, or `tickets`):
- List: `GET /crm/v3/objects/{object}?limit=100&properties=firstname,lastname,email` (paginate with `after` from `paging.next.after`)
- Get one: `GET /crm/v3/objects/{object}/{id}?properties=...`
- Search: `POST /crm/v3/objects/{object}/search` body `{filterGroups: [{filters: [{propertyName, operator: "EQ"|"CONTAINS_TOKEN"|..., value}]}], properties: [...], limit}`
- Create: `POST /crm/v3/objects/{object}` body `{properties: {...}}`
- Update: `POST /crm/v3/objects/{object}/{id}` with `method: "PATCH"` and body `{properties: {...}}`
- Associations: `GET /crm/v4/objects/{object}/{id}/associations/{toObject}`

Rules:
- Check `status`; HubSpot errors carry `{status: "error", message, category}`. `MISSING_SCOPES` means the private app lacks the scope: say which scope, do not retry.
- Property names are internal names (`firstname`, `hs_object_id`), not display labels; `GET /crm/v3/properties/{object}` lists them.
- Respect rate limits (HTTP 429 with `Retry-After`); batch endpoints (`/batch/read`, `/batch/create`) for more than a handful of records.
- Email addresses identify contacts; search before creating to avoid duplicates.
